repos.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
repos.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 175,000+ scientists worldwide. 163 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive library of validated skills designed to transform AI agents into specialized scientific researchers.
bullets: Built on a Python-based architecture with 163 modular, validated agent skills.
Integrates with over 100 scientific databases to provide domain-specific context for LLMs.
Enables agentic workflows for automated hypothesis generation, data analysis, and literature review.
Designed for high-precision research tasks requiring verifiable scientific reasoning.

repos.name: abi/screenshot-to-code
repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered tool that converts UI screenshots into clean, production-ready frontend code.
bullets: Utilizes GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet to interpret visual layouts and generate code.
Supports multiple modern stacks including React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, and HTML.
Accelerates the development lifecycle by automating the translation of design mockups to functional components.
Features a robust backend for handling image processing and streaming code generation.

repos.name: every-app/open-seo
repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.one_liner: An open-source, self-hosted alternative to enterprise SEO platforms like Semrush and Ahrefs.
bullets: Provides infrastructure for competitive analysis, keyword tracking, and site auditing.
Built with a modern TypeScript stack to handle large-scale data aggregation and indexing.
Offers a cost-effective solution for developers and marketers to monitor search performance.
Focuses on data transparency and ownership compared to proprietary SaaS alternatives.

repos.name: tt-a1i/archify
repos.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
repos.one_liner: An agent-driven tool for generating verifiable, interactive architecture and data-flow diagrams.
bullets: Generates self-contained HTML files featuring motion-based visualization and crisp exports.
Automates the documentation of complex system lifecycles, sequence flows, and data architectures.
Integrates into agentic workflows to provide visual transparency for technical infrastructure.
Ideal for engineering teams needing to maintain up-to-date, verifiable system documentation.
repos.img2_alt: Agent workflow playing one authored chapter

repos.name: chrisgreg/boop
repos.description: A tiny, self-hosted notification inbox for developers. Something happened in one of your apps; Boop tells you on your phone.
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, self-hosted notification infrastructure for developers to monitor application events.
bullets: Written in Go for high performance and minimal resource footprint in production environments.
Provides a centralized inbox for real-time alerts triggered by various microservices or backend processes.
Simplifies the observability stack by pushing critical system notifications directly to mobile devices.
Designed for easy deployment as a standalone service within existing infrastructure.
